data.rationale: SRVO-050 collision fault at B10; cell stopped with gate closed. SOP-ROBOT-02 §2 requires a technician with in-date lockout/tagout and robot-cell entry to lock out and enter. W-12 lacks lockout/tagout, so assign W-19 (machine_repair, lockout_tagout, robot_cell_entry certs valid).
